summary: The diff wires DataView.prototype.getUint32 to the existing support helper get_view_value with ElementType::Uint32. Step 1 (this as view) and step 2 (littleEndian defaults to false when absent) are present, and step 3 delegates to GetViewValue. An explicitly passed undefined still reaches ToBoolean inside the helper, which gives the same result as the spec. The only other change is renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target. No special-casing, made-up values, swallowed errors, or unrelated edits were found. The GetViewValue steps (RequireInternalSlot, ToIndex ordering, bounds checks) live in the helper, which is outside this diff, so I did not verify them directly.
